items.title: NiCE Employment Engagement Manager (EEM): Intelligent Automation for Intraday Management
items.fullTitle: NiCE Employment Engagement Manager (EEM): Intelligent Automation for Intraday Management
items.description: In the contact center, workforce management (WFM) is the art of effectively forecasting staffing needs, scheduling accordingly, and then managing change. As smart as managers and their WFM technology are, they can pretty much count on encountering unplanned changes after the schedule is released. Intraday variances due to agents calling in sick, queues blowing up, volume being lower than forecasted, and the like can impact service levels, productivity and cost-effectiveness. Overstaffing eats away at earnings with higher average idle times and operational costs, while understaffing increases employee overtime and negatively impacts CSAT scores – and when CSAT scores tumble, customer churn increases.

items.fullTitle: Top 10 AI-First CX Trends to Lead in 2026
items.description: Customer experience is entering a new era, and it's AI-first. Change is accelerating, and the next year will set the pace. In this webinar, we'll reveal the Top 10 AI-first trends reshaping customer service in 2026 and the practical steps to stay ahead. We'll spotlight the shifts that matter most: AI agents that act (not just chat), experience memory that carries context across journeys, and orchestration that moves workflows seamlessly from intent to resolution. Align your leadership agenda with a practical roadmap for what to start, stop, and scale so customers get faster and more personal service, employees feel supported, and your business becomes more efficient, more profitable, and more loved.

items.title: Steering agentic IVA implementation from pilot to exponential efficiency
items.fullTitle: Steering agentic IVA implementation from pilot to exponential efficiency
items.description: Join us for a webinar exploring how organizations can successfully scale intelligent virtual agent (IVA) initiatives from initial pilots to enterprise-wide impact. The session will unpack the concept of “agentic” IVAs, or AI-powered agents that act with autonomy and purpose to drive measurable outcomes. Attendees will gain insights into the strategic frameworks that support scalable IVA deployments, including data integration and change management. Real-world case studies will demonstrate how leading enterprises have achieved efficiency through the adoption of an IVA. Participants will also learn practical tips for designing AI pilots that are set up for long-term success, avoiding common pitfalls and maximizing ROI. Whether you're just starting with an IVA or looking to optimize existing implementations, this webinar offers actionable guidance to accelerate your AI journey.
